title: Drink My Totem
description: Puts the Totem Of Undying in a bottle, not much else to say.
body: This resource pack takes a perfectly functional Totem of Undying, carefully shoves it into a bottle, seals it shut, and proudly sets it your inventory to use as a normal totem. There is no explanation, no greater purpose, and no benefit gained from this action. It simply felt right.
